note: Authoritative delivery-wave assignment. Every status item appears exactly once; assurance/control_plane/backlog.py refuses missing, duplicate, unknown and reverse-wave dependency entries.
contract_note: Wave and release-profile objects define intended outcomes. Existing lint enforces item_waves and declared dependency order, not every semantic field or profile rule below. Until BK-80 is complete, apply a recorded manual release review; these objects confer no deployment approval.

wave_contracts.name: Trusted foundations
wave_contracts.goal: Make identity, storage, test controls and evidence claims dependable before they support privileged work.
entry_conditions: Existing product and corpus scope are inventoried; control populations and known limitations are explicit.
exit_conditions: Assigned foundation contracts pass their required controls; unresolved end-to-end integration is owned by later registered work.
BK-80 is complete before any automatically derived production claim relies on the new profile or evidence-validity rules.
wave_contracts.scope: Infrastructure and evidence foundations; synthetic or specifically authorised local use only.
wave_contracts.release_claim: Foundation conformance; no permission for a client pilot or production deployment.

wave_contracts.name: Admission and commission
wave_contracts.goal: Establish who instructs, what is being asked and whether the work may proceed. D-041 personal signup and owned-workspace/new/reopen require no professional approval; approval is independently checked only for protected professional approvals/overrides, not inferred from an account or profile.
entry_conditions: Relevant W0 foundations are proven; identity and workspace boundaries are established.
exit_conditions: Ordinary screening and narrow emergency integration pass separately; substantive work cannot bypass clearance.
Commission, professional role and authority remain visible and can be revised without silently widening scope.
wave_contracts.scope: Access, admission, task framing and authority.
wave_contracts.release_claim: Bounded admission conformance; substantive-quality claims await the relevant later waves.

wave_contracts.name: Usable file and interactive briefing
wave_contracts.goal: Make files recognisable and let advocates provide and refine the brief through typed, spoken and uploaded material.
entry_conditions: Admission foundation is available; media processing cannot precede BK-69 permission and quarantine boundaries.
exit_conditions: Intake retrieves authorised existing material, reflects understanding and asks purposeful questions with pause and return behavior.
BK-79 proves originals, derivatives, processing and deletion through the served path; current Phase A contracts pass at target widths.
wave_contracts.scope: Matter navigation/re-entry, research placement, evidence inventory and the briefing loop.
wave_contracts.release_claim: Usable-file and briefing conformance; intake completeness is task-specific, never a full merits assurance.

wave_contracts.name: Worked legal file
wave_contracts.goal: Connect the legal position to attributed facts, primary authority, alternatives, proof and useful relief.
entry_conditions: Current propositions and sources are available; governing legal and jurisdictional premises can be inspected.
exit_conditions: Changed material predicates invalidate affected conclusions while preserving unrelated work and prior versions.
Thresholds, adverse case, remedies and evidence gaps are assessed on representative matters with named legal-premise review.
wave_contracts.scope: Reasoning dependencies, thresholds, research, proof, case theory and expert evaluation foundation.
wave_contracts.release_claim: Worked-file conformance at a stated advice maturity; not authority to act.

wave_contracts.name: Considered advice
wave_contracts.goal: Produce practical, candid advice and a reliable decision experience.
entry_conditions: The task-specific file is ready for the claimed maturity; unsupported premises and production limitations remain visible.
exit_conditions: Options, proportionality, enforceability, adverse case and doing nothing are compared where relevant; decisions are recorded.
Latency, failure, cancellation and recovery are measured; expert review assesses actual served answers and user understanding.
wave_contracts.scope: Advice, decision support, progress and degraded-service behavior.
wave_contracts.release_claim: Advice conformance for the evaluated population and scope; no autonomous client or court action.

wave_contracts.name: Authorised action support
wave_contracts.goal: Prepare and verify drafts, negotiation, witness work and hearing assistance within recorded authority.
entry_conditions: Current advice, approved versions and professional-role authority are available.
exit_conditions: Every material draft assertion is traceable and every proposed external action requires the appropriate authority.
Filing, service and communications distinguish intention, transmission and verified outcome; uncertain delivery is reconciled before retry.
wave_contracts.scope: Drafting, filing control, negotiation and court preparation.
wave_contracts.release_claim: Conformance of the approved action workflow; activation of external integrations requires a separate deployment decision.

wave_contracts.name: Continuity and closure
wave_contracts.goal: Carry responsibility, decisions and obligations through change, handover and closure.
entry_conditions: Worked-file and action histories are current; recipient and continuing-service authority are known.
exit_conditions: Handover is current and acknowledged; remaining responsibilities do not disappear during transfer.
Events update obligations; closure is blocked until required deadlines, originals, funds, retention and authority issues are resolved or validly transferred.
wave_contracts.scope: Ongoing service, conflict watch, handover, event capture and closure.
wave_contracts.release_claim: Continuity and closure conformance for the tested workflow.

wave_contracts.name: Production release
wave_contracts.goal: Prove the deployed system can safely sustain the specifically approved service.
entry_conditions: The chosen release scope names required features, items, populations and reviewers; unresolved exclusions are approved and cannot silently remove critical safeguards.
exit_conditions: All production-profile conditions and applicable cumulative journeys pass on the deployed configuration; counsel review remains current.
MFA, tenant/access boundaries, capacity, monitoring, restore, rollback, accessibility and privacy outcomes are independently evidenced.
wave_contracts.scope: A named deployment, configured providers/corpus, authorised user population and operational support model.
wave_contracts.release_claim: Production approval only after a recorded accountable decision; a wave label or aggregate green count is not approval.

release_profiles.name: Controlled prototype
release_profiles.scope: Ordinary local development with synthetic data is not a release and does not wait for whole-product completion. A controlled demonstration activates only the named safe paths using synthetic or specifically authorised material.
entry_conditions: For an activated demonstration, name its environment, operator, material authority and exercised paths.
Local coding and synthetic unit tests may proceed against isolated components; do not present an incomplete exercised user route as conformant.
Confidential client material requires the pilot identity, security and processing gates, including BK-85 and BK-86, even if the session is called a demonstration.
required_evidence: Current local controls for every exercised path
Human inspection of known limitations and data authority
excluded_claims: Phase A completion before all Phase A contracts and served proof pass
Considered legal advice merely because a demonstration returns an answer
Permission to process real client material without explicit authority
release_profiles.approval: This is a scope definition, not approval to run a demonstration or use client data. Record the accountable authorisation for the intended use.

conditional_items.when: the demonstration exercises registration, recovery or privileged matter access
any confidential client material is admitted, including a demonstration
adaptive lead investigation or advice is enabled in the declared scope
specialist delegation or delegated document generation is enabled in the declared scope

release_profiles.name: Bounded advocate pilot
release_profiles.scope: A named invited advocate population, authorised materials, declared corpus/jurisdiction and enabled feature set; supervised decisions and no undeclared external action.
entry_conditions: Publish the exact enabled user journeys, supported media/languages and remaining limitations.
Name qualified reviewers, stop conditions, incident owner and the expiry/review date of pilot approval.

conditional_items.when: any spoken, uploaded or mixed-media material is enabled
drafting, filing or negotiation is enabled
adaptive lead investigation or advice is enabled in the declared scope
specialist delegation or delegated document generation is enabled in the declared scope

required_evidence: Current served journey for enabled scope with expected populations
Current representative-matter model evaluation and qualified counsel review
Environment-specific security, privacy and recovery review
excluded_claims: Support for untested courts, languages, media or external actions
Automatic waiver of MFA or other material security requirements
release_profiles.approval: Pilot activation requires an explicit accountable, bounded approval naming material risks and compensating controls. No prototype decision or this plan grants it.

release_profiles.name: Named production release
release_profiles.scope: A specific deployment and release manifest defining users, tenancy, legal coverage, enabled features, processing, service levels and operating responsibilities.
entry_conditions: Publish the exact release manifest and all applicable pilot and production obligations.
Obtain a current qualified legal review of relied-on governing premises and professional-role restrictions.

conditional_items.when: adaptive lead investigation or advice is enabled in the declared scope
specialist delegation or delegated document generation is enabled in the declared scope

required_evidence: Current complete automated and served proof for the release manifest
Measured security, restore, rollback, accessibility, capacity and service outcomes on the deployment shape
excluded_claims: Approval inferred from row counts, a test-only PASS or a generated workbook
release_profiles.approval: No release is authorised by this plan. Accountable production sign-off is required; any material exception must be separately approved, owned, expiring and visible with compensating controls. D-013 does not grant a production MFA exception.

journey_model.principle: The 47 steps are observable obligations, not 47 mandatory screens. Take the Brief, Work the File and Advise share one current file and can loop.
normal_loop: Ask the smallest useful question or material request
Work the file and advise at permitted maturity
return_triggers: new material fact or conflicting source
new party, event, deadline or legal premise
advocate correction, disagreement or new task
journey_model.return_behavior: Invalidate affected conclusions, clearance and readiness; preserve unchanged work and history; explain the change and return to the earliest necessary assessment, not the start of a fixed questionnaire.
journey_model.stop_and_resume: Stop or pause when the task is answered at permitted maturity, material is unavailable, the advocate elects to pause, authority is missing or a justified refusal applies. Record the gap, consequence, owner and resume trigger; do not keep asking solely to fill empty fields.
journey_model.maturity: AM-01 to AM-05 are permissions for a particular output, not a confidence score or a one-way progress bar. New facts may downgrade readiness; action authority remains separate from advice quality.

readiness_plan.note: Authored sequence from the current state to a bounded pilot and a named production release, following the advocate's journey. Stages advance in journey order; a stage's exit is claimed only after the stages it depends on meet theirs. Every measured gap is derived at export from the registries -- this object carries intent, never a status, verdict or approval.

stages.name: A truthful baseline
stages.goal: Make every later claim measurable: the registry says what the code does, every required evidence level is counted, every served route has a contract, and the release scorecard describes the corpus the product actually reads.
actions: Land the evidence-population check and hold its exact, owned debt in known_failures.yaml.
Reconcile each feature's authored implementation state against its served code, feature by feature, with @implements and a named test -- never from a search result alone.
Correct items authored implementation none that carry behavioural PASS evidence, checking each against its source.
Bind every served route to a versioned command contract, or exclude it with a recorded reason; give each contract its current route.
Place criteria no packet claims as a final owner.
Re-measure assurance/specification/coverage.yaml against the published corpus snapshot.
Run assurance/gate/mutate.py to completion on a frozen tree so passing controls are shown able to fail.
pilot_exit: assurance/control_plane/backlog.py population reports only registered debt, and that debt shrinks with each stage.
trace reports no feature whose authored implementation contradicts its code.
Every served route is contracted or excluded with a reason.
The release scorecard's measurement is newer than the corpus publication it scores.
RG-11 is measured on the current tree.
production_exit: Pilot exit, held current on the production candidate.

stages.name: Arrive: sign in, see the files, re-enter, search
stages.goal: An advocate reaches their own workspace securely, recognises every file, re-enters where they left off and searches the corpus with honest coverage -- before any confidential material is handled.
actions: Build strong authentication end to end -- enrolment, challenge, recovery interplay and session binding -- against the begin-factor and complete-factor contracts.
Resolve the failing matter cover, board and reopen behaviour and bind its browser journey.
Bind the existing login and navigation journey phases to Arrive's browser criteria.
Clear the BLOCKED and STALE key-separation rows.
Prove the confidential path and key-processor engineering criteria.
Obtain counsel review of how search reports results, no results, unsupported coverage and an unavailable index.
pilot_exit: Every criterion of Arrive's pilot-required work is PASS on the current tree.
Strong authentication is PASS at every required level; no MFA exception is assumed.
Key separation carries no BLOCKED or STALE result.
production_exit: Confidential-path and key-processor production measures are PASS on the deployment shape.

stages.name: Open a matter: route, triage, screen conflict, admit substance
stages.goal: A new matter is routed correctly, an emergency admits only protective triage, conflicts are screened and quarantined, and substance is admitted only after competence, engagement and capacity are recorded.
actions: Wire the conflict-screen quarantine into the served path.
Complete integration and adversarial proof for the front-door screens, commission, role authority and emergency admission.
Bind browser journeys for routing, emergency triage and admission.
Run an approved bounded model evaluation of opening-message routing.
Obtain counsel review of admission, competence, engagement, capacity and emergency behaviour.
pilot_exit: Every criterion of Open a matter's pilot-required work is PASS, including counsel review.
production_exit: Pilot exit, signed off through the Conformance Record.

stages.name: Take the brief: account, objectives, parties, threads, chronology, material, evidence
stages.goal: The advocate's account is heard, held and reflected back; objectives and constraints are recorded; parties, threads and chronology are settled; material is admitted without establishing facts it has not; and evidence is inventoried.
actions: Build objectives and constraints as a recorded, correctable part of the commission.
Wire document extraction into the served intake path.
Sweep the case-file and intake proof debt packet by packet.
Bind browser journeys for chronology, material intake and evidence inventory.
Run a representative-matter model evaluation of listening, chronology and attribution.
Obtain counsel review of how facts, allegations, documents and transcripts are kept distinct.
pilot_exit: Every criterion of Take the brief's pilot-required work is PASS for the media the pilot manifest enables.
production_exit: Pilot exit, and multimodal criteria PASS for every medium the release manifest enables.
decisions: Is spoken, uploaded or mixed media enabled in the pilot? If yes, multimodal privacy, attribution and deletion work becomes pilot-blocking.

stages.name: Work the file: cause, limitation, forum, jurisdiction, deadlines, research, proof, theory
stages.goal: Legal analysis rests on attributed, reviewable premises and verified authority: limitation and deadlines are conditional on reviewed premises, research separates discovery from verification, and a correction reaches exactly what depended on it.
actions: Sweep the proof debt of the dependency, research, premise, advice-shape and remedy packets in order of size.
Run the approved full golden suite and record RG-21.
Run a representative-matter model evaluation across cause, limitation, forum and research.
Obtain counsel review of legal premises, computed deadlines and research conclusions.
Raise subsequent-treatment coverage and provision-to-authority linking, or serve their limits as explicit disclosures.
pilot_exit: Every criterion of Work the file's pilot-required work is PASS for the declared corpus and jurisdiction.
RG-21 is PASS.
production_exit: A current qualified review of relied-on governing premises is recorded.
decisions: Engage qualified counsel now: this stage carries the largest counsel-review population and is the critical path.
Approve the model budget for representative-matter evaluation and the full golden run, as bounded named runs.

stages.name: Advise: scenarios, recommendation, proportionality, decision, disagreement
stages.goal: Advice is given at the maturity the file permits, with scenarios and proportionality tested, the advocate's decision recorded and disagreement stated candidly.
actions: Reconcile scenarios, proportionality, decision record and disagreement against the served decision and comparison code, then build what is genuinely missing.
Build and run the expert-advocate evaluation gate with named reviewers.
Run the advocate trust evaluation with representative advocates.
Obtain counsel review of advice maturity, candour and reservations.
pilot_exit: The expert-advocate evaluation gate and the advocate trust evaluation are PASS.
Every criterion of Advise's pilot-required work is PASS at the advice maturity the pilot permits.
production_exit: A current representative professional-quality review is recorded.

stages.name: Act: negotiate, brief the drafter, draft, file, witnesses, hearing, court
stages.goal: Drafting, filing, negotiation and hearing work act only within recorded authority, never file or act externally without it, and never invent testimony.
actions: Reconcile drafting, filing control, witnesses, hearing readiness and in-court work against the served routes.
Build negotiation within recorded settlement authority beyond the existing concession guard.
Prove the drafting, filing, hearing and action-authority packets.
Bind browser journeys for the drafting package, action proposal and hearing pack.
Obtain counsel review of drafting verification, filing control and witness preparation.
pilot_exit: Only if the pilot manifest enables Act: every criterion of its enabled work is PASS.
production_exit: Every criterion of Act's work that the release manifest enables is PASS.
decisions: Is Act enabled in the pilot? Recommended: no -- exclude it from the pilot manifest and deliver it for production.

stages.name: Carry: proactive service, conflict watch, handover
stages.goal: Continuing work runs only when authorised, conflict screening continues as parties change, and responsibility moves only on acceptance.
actions: Reconcile proactive service, conflict watch and handover against the served service-job and handover code.
Prove the handover and proactive-service packets.
Bind browser journeys for handover offer, acceptance and declination.
Obtain counsel review of handover responsibility and proactive authorisation.
pilot_exit: Only for what the pilot manifest enables: every criterion of that work is PASS.
production_exit: Every criterion of Carry's enabled work is PASS.
decisions: Which of Carry is in the pilot? Recommended: handover yes, proactive service no.

stages.name: Close: capture events, close and reopen
stages.goal: Outcomes are captured, a matter closes truthfully, retention obligations hold, and reopening restores only what moved.
actions: Reconcile event capture, closure, reopening and retention against the served routes.
Prove the closure criteria.
Bind browser journeys for close and reopen.
Obtain counsel review of closure and retention behaviour.
pilot_exit: Only for what the pilot manifest enables: every criterion of that work is PASS.
production_exit: Every criterion of Close's enabled work is PASS.

stages.name: Leave: end the session and leave nothing behind
stages.goal: A session expires and logs out with confirmation, and nothing confidential remains reachable afterwards.
actions: Resolve the failing session-expiry and confirmed-logout behaviour.
Re-run the complete login-to-logout browser journey and bind its report.
pilot_exit: Every criterion of Leave's pilot-required work is PASS on a current complete journey report.
production_exit: Pilot exit, held on the deployment shape.

stages.name: Bounded advocate pilot
stages.goal: A named, invited advocate population uses the enabled journeys under supervision, with published limitations, named reviewers and stop conditions.
actions: Publish the pilot manifest: enabled journeys, media, languages, corpus, jurisdiction and limitations.
Name qualified reviewers, stop conditions, the incident owner and the approval expiry.
Run the environment-specific security, privacy and recovery review.
Run the representative-matter model evaluation and qualified counsel review for the enabled scope.
Obtain explicit, bounded, accountable pilot approval naming material risks and compensating controls.
pilot_exit: assurance/control_plane/backlog.py obligations pilot reports complete for the published manifest.
production_exit: Not applicable: the pilot confers no production approval.
decisions: Fix the pilot scope. Recommended: Arrive through Advise and Leave, typed text and documents, considered advice enabled; Act and proactive service excluded; handover included.

stages.name: Named production release
stages.goal: A specific deployment and release manifest is proven on its own shape: users, tenancy, legal coverage, enabled features, processing, service levels and operating responsibilities.
actions: Fix the deployment shape, making the transactional store the live writer only after its integration evidence and an approved migration rehearsal.
Measure security, restore, rollback, accessibility, capacity and service outcomes on that shape.
Measure latency, progress, cancellation and degraded-service behaviour on that shape.
Label the six release portfolios to their registered minimum membership.
Re-measure the release scorecard and the golden suite on the deployed corpus.
Obtain a current qualified legal review of relied-on governing premises and professional-role restrictions.
Obtain accountable production sign-off with any material exception separately approved, owned, expiring and visible.
pilot_exit: Not applicable: production follows a completed pilot.
production_exit: assurance/control_plane/backlog.py obligations production reports complete for the release manifest.
Every blocking release-scorecard row is PASS on the deployed corpus.
Every release portfolio meets its registered minimum membership.
decisions: Who labels the release portfolios, and by when.
